import Mathlib
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Rudin_exercise_4_12
  {α β γ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) :
  UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := by
  rw [uniformContinuous_iff] at hf hg ⊢
  rw [← uniformContinuous_iff] at hf hg ⊢
  rw [uniformContinuous_iff] at hf hg ⊢
  rw [UniformSpace.comap_comap]
  exact le_trans hf (by apply UniformSpace.comap_mono hg)
